# Independent public-evidence private-wire reference

The frozen producer emits 112 positive frames, 38 contextual rejection controls and four raw-wire grammar controls. The three source captures are independently checked actual v1/v2 public evidence. Native view IDs, correlation IDs and selected directory identity are synthetic wire context, not actual session or file authority. No SLUG implementation produces the expectations and no proof work runs here.

From this directory, reproduce using:

```sh
python3 -B wire_reference.py --lock execution-lock.json --attempt /absolute/fresh/output --check wire-v1.json
```

The producer discovers the repository and verifies the exact existing core corpus hash; it writes only the requested fresh attempt directory. Its own source, case plan and contract are hash-pinned before execution. The preliminary decimal-parent identity proposal was corrected to the inherited 16-lowercase-hex grammar before any output was generated; the original proposal remains in `pre-execution-proposal/`.

Private framing limits remain governed by the unchanged bounded newline codec. Valid examples are below all frame limits; the overlimit negative exceeds both interpretations. The browser does not originate private requests or trust raw latest-job discovery: native remembers the original export operation before begin and reconciles exactly that operation on uncertain delivery.
